text:
55세 여성, severe acute asthma exacerbation으로 입원함.

BP 130/85 mmHg
HR 110 bpm
RR 28 breaths/min
BT 37.2°C
SpO2 88% on room air

Wheezing severe함.

Albuterol 2.5 mg IV q4h 적용함.

High-flow nasal cannula 산소 지원 중.

Ventilator 사용함.

Negative fluid balance 확인됨.

Drowsy 상태임.

Respiratory therapist notify함.
